checks: Published ACL, private audience and draft boundaries filter actual payload; original attachment bytes and base64 overhead are hashed and estimated.
Native incremental delivery supplements a budget hole below a higher delivery cursor; explicit seen never suppresses input injection.
Delivery, seen and mention acknowledgement have independent exact facts and never complete the Invocation or an Action.
Unverified ACK is rejected; unknown sends retain a replay barrier and do not advance delivery; trusted not-sent reconciliation permits one new intent.
A later-starting member uses the frozen wave inputMaxSeq and cannot absorb an earlier member post from the same wave.
An oversized Wake source is explicitly blocked without truncation, send intent or exposure facts.
A cursor write fault rolls back receipt, per-message delivery and cursor facts atomically; immutable manifests cannot be rewritten.
Late verified transport evidence preserves historical exposure after revocation but cannot authorize another input or execution.
The send boundary rechecks recursive cross-Thread source ACL even when the destination Binding itself remains valid.
API reconstructed context still includes authorized prior delivery and seen history; wrong Session versions and forged member bindings are rejected.
Manifest request identity is exact and immutable; outer rollback and read-only database errors never manufacture committed manifests.
A native Session that already saw a later sequence cannot serve an older resumed Wake merely by filtering the new prompt; cold preparation is required.
Multiple verified transport receipts audit one logical input monotonically: later unknown cannot erase delivery or duplicate message exposure facts.
Pending send repair accepts verified historical evidence after terminal resource release without reopening the Invocation or authorizing another send.
scope: T07 context contract fixtures only; isolated SQLite, injected trusted evidence, no provider, business database or native transcript
